recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately — 21+ consecutive days of zero logged intake while on Wegovy (appetite suppressant) with an active cold. Even if partly a logging gap, the under-fuelling risk is critical during a running comeback on GLP-1. The protein floor (1.6 g/kg = 162 g/day) is unverifiable. Bring intake patterns and appetite changes to the Sep 15 teleconsultation with Dr Monnier — this is the most actionable item this week.

First run back is a step-down from the pre-illness 7.28 km — the 5 km test run on Sep 8 (HR 139.9, suffer 21) is the new demonstrated floor. Do not chase the 8 km planned session that was missed.
